얼마.x: How much is one of these apples?
얼마.e: 얼마예요? 'How much is it?'; 얼마나 = 'how much / how long'.

시골.x: My grandmother lives in the countryside.

회의.x: I have a meeting at two in the afternoon.

냉장고.x: The milk is in the fridge.

오토바이.ex: 제 동생은 오토바이를 타고 학교에 가요.
오토바이.x: My younger brother rides a motorcycle to school.
오토바이.e: Konglish via Japanese, from 'auto' plus 'bi(cycle)'; English speakers say 'motorcycle'.

깨다.m: to wake up; to sober up
깨다.x: It was noisy outside, so I woke up at dawn.
깨다.e: Homonym warning: another 깨다 means 'to break' (glass, eggs).
깨다.t: 깨다 is waking; 일어나다 is getting up, so you can 깨다 and still stay in bed.

재미.x: These days I'm enjoying studying Korean.
재미.e: Add 있다 or 없다: 재미있다 'fun', 재미없다 'boring'.
재미.t: 재미있게 보내세요! 'Have fun!' is a friendly goodbye before a trip or weekend.

침실.ex: 우리 집에는 침실이 두 개 있어요.
침실.e: Literally 'sleeping room'. -실 = room: 욕실, 교실, 사무실.

예전.x: My Korean has improved a lot compared to before.
예전.e: Built on 예 'old times', the same root as 옛날.

직장인.ex: 직장인들은 보통 아침 아홉 시까지 출근해요.
직장인.x: Office workers usually get to work by 9 a.m.

대리.ex: 김 대리님이 이번 프로젝트를 맡고 있어요.
대리.x: Assistant Manager Kim is in charge of this project.
대리.e: Literally 'manage on behalf of' — originally a deputy role.
대리.t: 대리운전 is a popular service where a driver takes you and your car home after drinking.

유료.ex: 이 주차장은 유료라서 돈을 내야 해요.
유료.x: This parking lot isn't free, so you have to pay.

가사.ex: 이 노래는 가사가 쉬워서 따라 부르기 좋아요.
가사.x: This song has easy lyrics, so it's good for singing along.
가사.e: Literally 'song words.' Homonym: 가사 can also mean housework.

가사.ex: 정철의 관동별곡은 조선 시대의 대표적인 가사입니다.
가사.x: Jeong Cheol's Gwandong Byeolgok is a representative gasa of the Joseon era.
가사.e: Literally 'song words' — long verse in four-beat lines, popular in Joseon.
가사.t: Don't confuse it with homonyms 가사 'song lyrics' and 가사 'housework'; context usually makes it clear.

지구.ex: 우리 모두 지구를 지키기 위해 노력해야 해요.
지구.x: We all need to work hard to protect the earth.
지구.t: Homonym: 지구 地區 means 'district, zone,' as in 개발 지구.

겸손하다.x: That athlete is famous but always humble.

감염.ex: 감염을 막으려면 손을 깨끗이 씻어야 해요.
감염.x: To prevent infection, you have to wash your hands well.
감염.e: Literally 'affected and stained', like dye seeping into cloth.
감염.t: 감염 is a person catching germs; 전염 is a disease spreading from person to person.

오프라인.x: We decided to meet in person for this gathering.
오프라인.e: From English 'offline'; in Korean it often means 'in person' or 'in a physical store.'

조언하다.x: My professor gave me advice about my career path.

다가오다.m: to approach, come closer, draw near
다가오다.ex: 시험이 다가와서 요즘 도서관에 자주 가요.
다가오다.x: Exams are coming up, so these days I often go to the library.
다가오다.e: 다가- 'closer' + 오다 'to come'; its partner is 다가가다 'to go closer'.

대사.ex: 그 드라마 마지막 대사가 아직도 기억나요.
대사.x: I still remember the last line of that drama.
대사.t: 대사를 외우다 = to memorize one's lines. Homonym: 대사 (大使) also means 'ambassador'.

관리.ex: 건강 관리를 위해서 매일 운동을 해요.
관리.x: I exercise every day to take care of my health.
관리.t: Pronounced [괄리]; 관리비 is the monthly maintenance fee in apartments.

위임하다.x: My team leader delegated this task to me.
위임하다.e: Literally 'entrust a duty' — handing your job or power to someone else.
위임하다.t: Common pattern: [person]에게 권한을 위임하다 — to delegate authority to someone.

도덕적.ex: 그 행동은 법적으로는 괜찮지만 도덕적으로는 문제가 있어요.
도덕적.x: That behavior is legally okay, but it's morally problematic.
도덕적.t: Pronounced [도덕쩍]; -적 words take 인 before nouns and 으로 as adverbs.

탈진.ex: 더운 날 물도 안 마시고 운동하다가 탈진했어요.
탈진.x: I exercised on a hot day without drinking water and got completely exhausted.
탈진.e: Literally 'stripped and used up' — every bit of energy is gone.

임신.ex: 아내가 임신 중이라서 요즘 같이 술을 안 마셔요.
임신.x: My wife is pregnant, so these days we don't drink.
임신.t: 임신하다 = to get pregnant; 임신 중이다 = to be pregnant; 임신 몇 개월이에요? asks how far along.

음반.ex: 그 가수는 3년 만에 새 음반을 냈어요.
음반.x: That singer released a new album for the first time in three years.
음반.t: Usually with 내다 or 발매하다: 음반을 내다 'to release an album'.

시상식.ex: 연말이 되면 방송사마다 큰 시상식을 해요.
시상식.x: When the year ends, every TV network holds a big awards ceremony.
시상식.e: Literally 'prize-giving ceremony'; 시상 is giving, 수상 is receiving.

절전.ex: 여름에는 절전을 위해 에어컨 온도를 높이세요.
절전.x: In summer, raise the air conditioner temperature to save electricity.
절전.t: On devices you'll see 절전 모드 = power-saving or sleep mode.

고소.x: He was defrauded, so he filed a complaint against the other person.
고소.t: 고소 is filed by the victim; 고발 is filed by a third party. Note 고소하다 also means 'nutty, savory'.

중개업소.x: I went to a neighborhood real estate office and looked into studio apartments.
중개업소.t: In everyday speech people simply say 부동산 for a real estate office.

진술.m: statement (to police or in court), account
진술.ex: 두 사람의 진술이 서로 달라서 조사가 길어졌어요.
진술.x: The two people's statements didn't match, so the investigation dragged on.

실은.m: actually, in fact, to tell the truth
실은.ex: 실은 어제 너한테 할 말이 있었어.
실은.x: Actually, I had something to tell you yesterday.
실은.e: 실 'truth, reality' + topic particle -은: 'as for the truth'.

감수하다.m: to accept (willingly), to put up with, to bear (a risk or loss)
감수하다.ex: 성공하려면 어느 정도의 위험은 감수해야 해요.
감수하다.x: To succeed, you have to accept a certain amount of risk.
감수하다.e: Literally 'receive as if sweet': accept something bad without complaint.
감수하다.t: Typical collocations: 위험을 감수하다, 손해를 감수하다, 불편을 감수하다.

물러나다.m: to step back, retreat; to resign, step down
물러나다.x: The company president stepped down because of health problems.
물러나다.t: Use 물러나다 for stepping down from a post; 물러서다 is more for physically backing up or backing down.

물리치다.m: to defeat, repel; to turn down, reject
물리치다.ex: 우리 팀이 강한 상대를 물리치고 결승에 올랐어요.
물리치다.x: Our team beat a strong opponent and made it to the finals.
물리치다.e: Probably 물리다 'to push back' + 치다 'to strike'.

탄탄하다.ex: 그 회사는 기술력이 탄탄해서 믿을 수 있어요.
탄탄하다.x: That company has solid technology, so you can trust it.
탄탄하다.e: Doubled syllable for firmness; used for muscles, stories and businesses alike.

푸짐하다.x: This restaurant serves generous side dishes.

허술하다.x: Security was so lax that personal information was leaked.
허술하다.t: Often about systems and plans: 관리가 허술하다 'management is lax'. Compare 허름하다 'run-down'.

하늘의 별 따기.forms: 하늘의 별 따기예요 / N이/가 하늘의 별 따기
하늘의 별 따기.m: next to impossible, extremely hard to get
하늘의 별 따기.ex: 요즘 서울에서 집을 사는 건 하늘의 별 따기예요.
하늘의 별 따기.x: Buying a home in Seoul these days is next to impossible.
하늘의 별 따기.e: Literally 'picking a star from the sky'.
nb: 발 없는 말이 천 리 간다

눈길을 끌다.forms: 눈길을 끌어요 · 눈길을 끌었어요 · 눈길을 끄는 (+noun) (ㄹ drops)
눈길을 끌다.m: to catch the eye, to attract attention
눈길을 끌다.ex: 그 가게의 독특한 간판이 사람들의 눈길을 끌었어요.
눈길을 끌다.x: That store's unique sign caught people's eye.
눈길을 끌다.e: 눈길 = line of sight (eye + road); literally 'to pull someone's gaze.'
눈길을 끌다.t: Pronounced [눈낄]: the ㄱ is tensed in this compound.

이점.ex: 온라인 수업은 시간을 아낄 수 있다는 이점이 있어요.
이점.x: Online classes have the advantage of saving time.
이점.t: Pronounced [이쩜]; 이점 is a benefit you gain, while 장점 is a good quality.

인테리어.x: I did the interior design of our new home myself.
인테리어.t: 인테리어 공사 means renovating the inside of a home or shop.

그 결과.forms: A. 그 결과 B. · N의 결과 · -(으)ㄴ 결과
그 결과.ex: 매일 운동했어요. 그 결과 오 킬로가 빠졌어요.
그 결과.x: I exercised every day. As a result, I lost five kilos.
그 결과.t: Common in writing, reports and presentations; in conversation people often say 그래서 or 결국.

진전되다.m: to progress, to make headway, to develop
진전되다.ex: 두 나라의 협상이 조금씩 진전되고 있습니다.
진전되다.x: Negotiations between the two countries are making progress little by little.
진전되다.t: The noun often goes with 있다/없다: 진전이 없다 (no progress).

재개하다.x: The two countries resumed talks that had been suspended for a year.

의거하다.m: to be based on, to act in accordance with
의거하다.ex: 모든 처벌은 법에 의거해서 이루어져야 합니다.
의거하다.x: All punishment must be carried out in accordance with the law.

뒤섞다.m: to mix up, to jumble, to shuffle
뒤섞다.ex: 카드를 잘 뒤섞은 다음에 한 장씩 나눠 주세요.
뒤섞다.x: Shuffle the cards well, then deal them out one at a time.
뒤섞다.e: 뒤- here is an intensifier 'all over' + 섞다 'to mix': mixing thoroughly.

저버리다.m: to let down, to betray; to break (a promise), to turn one's back on
저버리다.x: I don't want to let my parents down.
저버리다.t: Typical objects: 기대 'expectations', 약속 'promise', 신뢰 'trust', 은혜 'kindness'.

터무니없다.x: This restaurant's prices are outrageously expensive.
터무니없다.e: 터무니 means 'grounds, basis' + 없다 'not have': 'without any basis'.
터무니없다.t: The adverb 터무니없이 is very common: 터무니없이 비싸다.

기개.ex: 그 독립운동가는 끝까지 기개를 굽히지 않았습니다.
기개.x: That independence activist never bent his spirit to the very end.
기개.e: Literally 'spirit and integrity' — an unbending moral backbone.

병 주고 약 준다.forms: 병 주고 약 주네요 · 병 주고 약 주는 거예요?
병 주고 약 준다.m: to hurt someone and then offer help; to cause a problem, then pretend to fix it
병 주고 약 준다.ex: 실컷 혼내고 나서 선물을 주다니, 병 주고 약 주네요.
병 주고 약 준다.x: Scolding me all that time and then giving me a gift? You hurt me, then try to make it better.
병 주고 약 준다.e: Literally 'give someone a disease, then give them medicine.'

기제.ex: 스트레스가 몸에 영향을 주는 기제를 연구하고 있어요.
기제.x: They are studying the mechanism by which stress affects the body.
기제.e: Literally 'machine control' — the workings behind a process.
기제.t: Mostly in academic writing; in psychology, 방어 기제 means 'defense mechanism'.

마진.ex: 이 제품은 마진이 적어서 많이 팔아야 해요.
마진.x: This product has a thin margin, so we have to sell a lot.
마진.e: From English 'margin'; in Korean it almost always means profit margin.

포털.m: portal (site), web portal (such as Naver or Daum)
포털.x: Most people read the news on portal sites.
포털.e: From English 'portal'; in Korea it means big all-in-one sites like Naver.

관용성.ex: 다양한 문화가 공존하려면 사회의 관용성이 필요합니다.
관용성.x: For diverse cultures to coexist, a society needs tolerance.
관용성.t: Homonym: 관용(慣用) means customary usage, as in 관용 표현 'idiom'.

노사분규.x: As the labor dispute dragged on, the factory stopped operating.

담보대출.x: I took out a secured loan from the bank to buy a house.
담보대출.e: Literally 'guaranteed lending' — a loan backed by property.
담보대출.t: Say 대출을 받다 for taking out a loan; 대출을 갚다 means paying it back.

애달프다.m: to be heartrending, poignant, achingly sad
애달프다.x: The song longing for someone who left is heartbreaking.
애달프다.e: Probably from 애 'insides, heart' (as in 애타다) + 닳다 'wear away': heart-wearing sadness.

혈전.ex: 오래 앉아 있으면 다리에 혈전이 생길 수 있어요.
혈전.x: Sitting for a long time can cause blood clots in your legs.
혈전.e: Literally 'blood plug' — a clot that stoppers the vessel.
혈전.t: Don't confuse it with 혈전 meaning 'bloody battle' (血戰) — same sound, different word.

고전소설.ex: 춘향전은 지금도 학교에서 많이 읽히는 고전소설이에요.
고전소설.x: Chunhyangjeon is a classical novel still widely read in schools today.
고전소설.e: Literally 'old-classic novel'; 소설 originally meant 'petty talk', minor stories.

신권.m: power of the ministers (vs. royal power)
신권.ex: 조선 초기에는 왕권과 신권이 서로 대립했어요.
신권.x: In early Joseon, royal power and the ministers' power clashed.
신권.e: Literally 'subjects' power', the counterweight to royal power.
신권.t: Homonym: 신권 also means newly issued banknotes; in history texts it means ministers' power.

안채.m: inner quarters (women's and family living building of a hanok)
안채.x: The inner quarters were mainly where the women lived.
안채.e: 안 (inside) + 채 (counter for buildings): the inner building; compare 사랑채, 바깥채.

수주대토.m: foolishly waiting for luck to repeat, clinging to old ways
수주대토.ex: 옛날 방식만 고집하는 건 수주대토와 같아요.
수주대토.x: Sticking only to old methods is like waiting by the stump for another rabbit.
수주대토.e: A farmer saw a rabbit hit a stump, then waited there forever for another.

쇄도하다.m: to pour in, to flood in, to rush
쇄도하다.x: Orders for the new product are pouring in.
쇄도하다.e: Literally 'arrive intensely' — everything rushes in at once.

운운하다.m: to talk about, to mention (dismissively), to say this and that
운운하다.x: Before going on about responsibility, let's check the facts first.
운운하다.e: Literally 'say, say' — 'and so on and so forth.'
운운하다.t: Often slightly critical: someone keeps bringing something up inappropriately.

자처하다.m: to call oneself, to pose as; to bring on oneself
자처하다.e: Literally 'place oneself' in a role or situation.
자처하다.t: 고생을 자처하다 means to choose hardship voluntarily.

혼재하다.m: to coexist in a mix, to be mixed together
혼재하다.ex: 이 도시에는 전통과 현대가 혼재해 있어요.
혼재하다.x: In this city, tradition and modernity exist side by side.
혼재하다.e: Literally 'exist mixed' — different things present side by side.

도도하다.x: She turned her head away with a haughty look.
도도하다.e: Homonym warning: another 도도하다 means 'surging, sweeping' (of rivers or historical trends).
도도하다.t: Can be half-complimentary for a chic, aloof woman, closer to 'aloof' than plainly 'rude'.

희한하다.x: I had a really weird dream last night.
희한하다.e: Literally 'rare, rare': something you almost never see.
희한하다.t: Common spelling mistake: 희안하다 is wrong; the correct form is 희한하다.

능소능대.m: versatile, able to handle anything big or small
능소능대.ex: 그는 능소능대해서 어떤 일을 맡겨도 잘해요.
능소능대.x: He is so versatile that he does well at whatever you give him.
능소능대.e: Literally 'able in small things, able in big things'.
능소능대.t: Can work as a 하다 adjective: 능소능대하다.
